confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors draw mainly on Avignon cost-of-living aggregates (Numbeo-derived figures, MyLifeElsewhere, CityCost, combien-coute.net). Their dates are mixed and they disagree by up to about a third on mid-range meals. Beer is a 0.5 L draught basis. Cocktail was set from the local beer relationship because no reliable Avignon cocktail average was found. wine_glass rests mainly on one wine-bar reference of uncertain date, so both are less certain. EUR was converted at about 1.10 USD per EUR, implied by mid-2026 USD figures in the sources; this FX basis was not separately verified. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July festival-season demand; no booking pages or listings were inspected.
comparable_city_reasoning: No separate comparable city was used for food and drink: meal, coffee and beer anchors are Avignon-specific aggregates. Cocktail is set relative to the local draught beer anchor, and wine_glass is checked against one wine-bar reference. Accommodation is a model estimate based on comparable mid-sized southern French tourist cities in the July festival season.
